# Världens bästa börs – från Dracula till Nietzsche

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-08-14  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Recorded from Romania near Bran ('Dracula's') Castle, this EFN Börssurr episode roams from Romania's Bucharest exchange (BET up ~70% on energy/inflation) as 'the world's best bourse' to the AI-fuelled melt-up in US equities, a possible record Anthropic IPO, and soaring private valuations (Lovable). The hosts argue pharma/healthcare should be a larger, hedge-like portfolio component as AI rotation reverses, and discuss Swedish corporate news: Leif Sinnes's abrupt SBB exit and new CEO Andreas Morfiadakis, fund-industry consolidation (Mandatum, Carnegie/DNB, Öhman/Lannebo), Volvo's slump, Maersk's raised guidance and the Trustor documentary. Overall constructive on AI and pharma, wary of stretched valuations and rising long-term rates.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 SBB-B — SBB (Samhällsbyggnadsbolaget i Norden) | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Sinnes fired abruptly post-rescue; new CEO Morfiadakis plus a fresh related-party paper profit raise questions of a strategy/tempo shift.

#### Reasoning

Hosts are puzzled by firing the CEO who saved SBB and suspicious of a quick complex related-party deal writing up values SEK100m with no real cash. They speculate a shift from consolidation/clean-up toward a more offensive expansion phase, but say they need to meet the new CEO before forming a view — low conviction, wait-and-see.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new management resumes aggressive value write-ups without cash
- if related-party dealmaking escalates
- if leverage rises again

> *"En klassisk ilja, en komplex affär med närstående bolag där man skrev upp några värden med 100 miljoner utan att några riktiga pengar verkar ha bytt ägare."*

---

### 🟠 YUBICO — Yubico | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Up ~40% in a week after report; 'strength breeds strength' momentum, possibly boosted by AI/security association.

#### Reasoning

Hosts note Yubico rushed after its report and is up over 40% in a week, framing it as momentum ('styrka föder styrka') possibly tied to the AI theme. No fundamental thesis given — purely an observation of strong momentum, so a speculative watch rather than a conviction call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if momentum reverses
- if AI/security narrative fades

> *"vi pratade om Yubico förra veckan efter Rapport när den rusade. Nu är den upp 40 procent på en vecka drygt. Styrka föder styrka."*

---

### 🟠 KLARA-B — Klarabo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down ~70% in 5 years, high discount, listed at market peak; hosts skeptical but attribute much to bad luck/timing rather than poor management.

#### Reasoning

Company built by SBB's incoming CEO; hosts question why its leader is a 'given' choice given Klarabo trades at one of the highest discounts and performed very poorly, but argue the IPO landed at the 2021 top (max bad luck) and management may still be skilled. Uncertain, wait to meet the CEO.

#### Sell Triggers

- if discount persists or widens
- if operational performance stays weak

> *"Men vadå, Klarabo är ju ner 70 procent på fem år. Havererade väl fullständigt efter 21 hysterin på något sätt."*
